messages:
sam (partnerships): Heads-up: Datadog partner asked to demo an inline telemetry widget inside our marketplace tile next Wed (APAC slot). Need eng + obs + SI alignment. Who owns the handoff?
keiko (si lead): I can own SI handoff. Will need an integration spec, a local collector example, and agentless fallback for airgapped installs.
maria (obs PM): Ill own dashboard UX and sample queries. Please share OTLP exporter config, sample spans, and retention guidance.
jake (eng): I can prototype the embed. Qs: 1) auth model? 2) CORS/CSP for iframe tile?
datadog-bot: Partner portal reminder: submit MarketplaceTileIntegration form at https://partners.datadog.example/submit ". Include ingest region and endpoints.
sam (partnerships): Two auth options: KMS-signed JWT from our control plane or short-lived token minted by Datadog proxy. Preference: signed JWT for trace provenance. @jake can we sign?
jake (eng): Yes. We can mint JWTs via KMS. Need rotation plan + JWK endpoint. I can build middleware to validate and inject session headers. ETA ~48h.
keiko (si lead): For airgap: containerized collector + env var samples + file-buffer fallback. Need TLS pinning guide for gov customers.
maria (obs PM): Dashboard: tabs for traces, errors, perf heatmap. If Datadog provides a JSON export well import. Sample span for demo: {"trace_id":"abcd1234","span":"inference.request","service":"redwood-inference","latency_ms":12,"attrs":{"model":"redwood-13b","region":"apac-1"}}
jake (eng): For demo ingest, suggest 1% sampling baseline to keep token counts low. Need OTLP URL + headers.
sam (partnerships): Data residency: APAC tile must keep traces in-region. Datadog rep said regional ingestion keys exist. Confirm?
datadog-bot: APAC endpoints: https://apac.datadoghq.com. Regional ingestion and limited-routing keys supported via partner account. Contact partners-asia@datadog.example.
maria (obs PM): Also need suggested widgets and monitors. @datadog-bot any sample LLM inference dashboard export?
datadog-bot: Sample export: https://dd.example/sample-llm-inference-dashboard.json (traces, latency heatmap, error monitor).
jake (eng): Plan: small JWT middleware + CORS headers on tile, JWK endpoint, rotate keys every 30 days. Will prototype.
keiko (si lead): Ill draft SI checklist and airgap docs (collector image + config + buffers).
sam (partnerships): Owners & ETA: Jake - JWT + CORS prototype (48h). Maria - import dashboard draft (48h). Keiko - SI collector + airgap doc (72h). Sam - submit partner form and confirm demo slot. Weekly sync Thu 09:30 PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:
